summary: Acer 16 Predator Neo has constant BSODs and screen freezes, particularly during transitions to resource-intensive tasks. The system is prone to BSODs and screen freezes, especially when switching between the integrated GPU (iGPU) and dedicated GPU (dGPU). Overclocking and BIOS/Firmware issues have been suggested as potential causes.
detected_fault: Driver conflicts or incompatibilities with thermal throttling or overclocking
suggested_solution: Update PC BIOS/UEFI firmware to the latest version, update hardware device drivers, turn off overclocking, clean dust and blockages from the system, run latency monitoring tools.
